mutant.lineText: if (parts.some((x) => x.length > 255)) return { kind: 'unknown', source: path.slice(0, 100), reason: 'a name is longer than 255 characters' };
mutant.prevText: if (parts.length === 0) return { kind: 'unknown', source: path, reason: 'empty path' };
mutant.nextText: if (parts.includes('..')) return { kind: 'unknown', source: path, reason: 'path climbs out of the library' };
